# Moody Spurgeon MacPherson

[Queen’s Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy)

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v3 ch.Relationships P4](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0004)</sub>
- **Role:** school teacher (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Relationships P4](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0004)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Moody Spurgeon MacPherson is a funny-looking boy characterized by a big, round fat face and small blue eyes. His prominent ears stick out like flaps and remain an objectionable feature of his appearance.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v3 ch.Autumn P4](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0004)_

## Personality

Moody Spurgeon is a very serious young man who plans to become a minister, though he notes it would be easier to work as a carpenter. He suffers from anxiety regarding his academic performance, feeling in his bones that he is going to fail in English history.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XXXI. Where the Brook and River Meet P28](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out P20](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0020), [v3 ch.B.A.’s P41](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0041)_

## Traits

- failing in English history  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXI. Where the Brook and River Meet P28](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0028)</sub>

## Goals

- going to be a minister  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out P20](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0020)</sub>

## History

Moody Spurgeon was a student from [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) who pursued higher education. After leaving Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy), he worked as a schoolteacher.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P4](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0004)_

## Background by volume

**Volume 3**

- taught school after leaving Queen's  <sub>[v3 ch.Relationships P4](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0004)</sub>
